description: Built on the cmdk library. Provides a command palette with type-ahead filtering. The list of results uses role="listbox" and items are selectable via keyboard.

keyboard.action: Moves highlight to the next item in the list
Moves highlight to the previous item in the list
Moves focus to/from the command input
Closes the command palette when used inside a dialog

focus.notes: Focus starts in the search input. Arrow keys move a virtual highlight through the filtered results without moving DOM focus from the input.

announcements: The input is announced as a search field
Highlighted items are announced as the user arrows through the list
Group labels are announced to provide context for grouped items

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for item labels and input text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for highlight indicator and borders)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide a meaningful placeholder for the search input
When used inside a dialog, ensure the dialog has an accessible label
Include an empty-state message when no results match the filter
